name: Forward
project_description:
Adds a "forward this page" link to each node. This module allows users to email a specific node or other entity on your site to a friend. You can customize the link text and icon and choose the view modes on which the link appears. You can also customize the email template to match the rest of your site. The module includes a report on which pages are forwarded the most and a log of all forwarding activity.

 Pathologic 
 Although not required for every use case, it is recommended that you install the Pathologic module and use it as the Filter on the Forward Settings page. This will ensure that any relative links are properly converted to the absolute links required for email. If you have broken links in your email, this will most likely fix it.

 Drupal 11 
 The 4.0.4 release is now compatible with Drupal 11.

 Drupal 10 
 The 4.0.3 release is stable and has fixed a number of bugs with Drupal 10 support. If you tried 4.0.2 and had trouble, try upgrading to 4.0.4 and things should be working much more smoothly.

 Drupal 9 
 The 4.0.3 release is the final release that supports Drupal 9 (which has been End-of-Life since 2023-11-01). If you're still on Drupal 9, you're strongly encouraged to upgrade to Drupal 10 or 11 ASAP.

 Drupal 8 
 The 4.0.2 release was the last release that supported Drupal 8 (which has been EOL since 2021-11-02). Any sites still on Drupal 8 are strongly encouraged to upgrade. No further development that supports that version will be done.
